hooks.command: command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'Blocked: this hook needs jq to read the command. Install jq.' >&2; exit 2; }; cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); br=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); g='(^|[;&|[:space:]])git([[:space:]]+-[^[:space:]]+([[:space:]]+[^-[:space:]][^[:space:]]*)?)*[[:space:]]+'; if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq "${g}push([[:space:]][^;&|]*)?[[:space:]]\+?([^[:space:]:;&|]*:)?(refs/heads/)?main([[:space:];&|]|$)" || { [ "$br" = main ] && printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq "${g}(commit|push)([[:space:];&|]|$)"; }; then echo 'Blocked by a project hook: no commits or pushes to main. Create a feature branch first.' >&2; exit 2; fi
